purpose: Map the tracked surfaces needed to distinguish native Windows OpenCode, the AgentSwitchboard Windows shim, and the WSL Ubuntu OpenCode runtime without mutating workstation state.

knownRuntimeSurfaces.role: native OpenCode installation used by native GNHF integration
AgentSwitchboard command shim that delegates to WSL Ubuntu
Linux OpenCode installation repaired by the technician live-cert path
recorded adapter command identity; evidence only until compared with effective child resolution

commands.name: Observed current-process status

commands.name: Completeness validator

knownTraps: opencode debug config proves resolved configuration, not which executable a later child process spawns.
Get-Command opencode in the parent PowerShell proves only that parent process resolution.
AgentSwitchboard can expose both a native Windows npm OpenCode and a Windows opencode.cmd shim that delegates to WSL Ubuntu.
The technician readiness path prepends the AgentSwitchboard shim root to the user PATH and rebuilds process PATH with AgentSwitchboard, agy, Hermes, and npm locations.
A healthy WSL OpenCode installation does not prove a native Windows OpenCode launch is using the intended executable.
A state.json commandPath is declared adapter state, not effective child-process proof.
uv or uv_spawn failures must be attributed to the exact failing process and environment rather than inferred from an unrelated parent-shell uv command.
Harness-only diagnosis never edits PATH, removes shims, reinstalls OpenCode, or changes launcher product code.
proofCeiling: Tracked runtime-resolution contracts, deterministic synthetic collision classification, read-only repository/current-process observation, and exact repair routing only. It does not prove the failing OpenCode child process identity until that exact launch chain is observed end to end.
